compact_schema.s: C changed, A already agrees, H held
compact_schema.b: before [population,population_year], null may mean absent; full row guard in patch/full ledger
compact_schema.c: bound INEGI entity code, 9 digits localidad / 5 digits municipio; null if held
compact_schema.d: CSC to ITER locality point distance km; null for municipio/held
compact_schema.m: covering municipio codes from original INEGI polygons

methods.census: INEGI Censo de Población y Vivienda 2020, reference date 2020-03-15. Parse national ITER CSV POBTOT directly. MUN !=000; municipio LOC=0000, individual localidad LOC !=0000/9998/9999. Counts are never exchanged across these scopes. CSV line numbers are 1-based including header. ZIP CRC test and SHA-256 verified.
methods.identity: Require compatible row type and own-item P31, exact normalized full/base official name, own-item labels/aliases, same estado, and same municipio independently checked by unbuffered valid INEGI municipal polygon coverage. Own P1976 locality/P3801 municipio must agree where present; any cross-scope class/code conflicts held. Municipio requires own single P3801 and sole P31 municipality of Mexico. Only population and population_year change.
methods.point: Haversine distance to ITER locality point: <=300 m population <2500; <=500 m <15000; <=800 m <100000; <=1500 m otherwise. Without own P1976, own-item P625 must independently satisfy the same threshold. No coordinate moves or fuzzy name match. Current catalogue must retain the same active code, municipio and compatible name.
methods.temporal: Current June 2026 catalogue crosschecks entity continuity. Municipio also requires current catalogue POB_TOTAL equal ITER total to hold reform/extent inconsistencies. The current boundary edition is used only for municipio containment, never for population. No historical municipality area equality is inferred from containment. Existing newer stored years or matching own-item post-2020 counts are preserved and held pending primary verification. All existing dated rows undergo the same checks.
methods.unresolved: Start with pinned unresolved baseline then apply later identity events. All 214 latest-unresolved MX keys are held; no new classification decisions or identity events. Thirty-three previously reviewed classification decisions may bind normally. No current label/point inference overrides an unresolved v4 identity.
methods.names: NFKD accents removed, casefold, punctuation to spaces, whitespace collapsed. Official printed parentheses/brackets may be removed to compare the base name. Row native spelling may corroborate row name. No substring/fuzzy matching.
methods.evidence: Full per-record evidence, candidates and failed checks are retained in ledger_full_mx_pop_v5x.jsonl in work. Compact ledger covers all rows; resolve indexes through this sidecar. Archived sources are hash-verified against original acquisition receipts; retrieval timestamps are original capture times, not this build time. Live extra own items, class definitions, terms and publication notice fetched for this audit.
methods.hold: Held values remain byte-for-byte unchanged, including any potentially wrong existing 2020 values. A held row is not verified as agreeing. Every row appears once in review.csv and the compact ledger.
